title: Large black holes at a finite distance: Quasi-local restricted phase space formalism
summary: We extend the restricted phase space formalism for spherically symmetric black hole solutions of Einstein-Maxwell theory to the quasi-local regime, with the static observers located at a finite radial distance. The first law and Euler relation for the RN and RN-AdS black holes are proved to hold, but only with the inclusion of an extra pair of thermodynamic variables, {\em i.e.} the pressure $P$ and the area $A$ of the codimension-2 hypersurface on which the observers reside.
